posts.name: Anirvan
posts.cooked:
When I try to connect to remote VM, I encounter this issue:

Command:

PS C:\Users\sony\.ssh> ssh 23f2000628@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in

Result:
ssh: connect to host se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in port 22: Connection timed out

My internet connection is fine:

PS C:\Users\sony\.ssh> ping se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in

Pinging se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in [194.195.113.53] with 32 bytes of data:
Reply from 194.195.113.53: bytes=32 time=53ms TTL=48
Reply from 194.195.113.53: bytes=32 time=49ms TTL=48
Reply from 194.195.113.53: bytes=32 time=49ms TTL=48R
eply from 194.195.113.53: bytes=32 time=50ms TTL=48

Ping statistics for 194.195.113.53:
   Packets: Sent = 4, Received = 4, Lost = 0 (0% loss),
Approximate round trip times in milli-seconds:
   Minimum = 49ms, Maximum = 53ms, Average = 50ms

Can anyone help me with this problem?

posts.name: Adarsh "23F2" K
posts.cooked: it’s probably some system that accepted your connection, but kept you waiting.

posts.name: Anirvan
posts.cooked: @Mrinal.exe Sir please kindly have a look at this problem.

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Can you please try changing your internet connection and see if it work.

posts.name: Anirvan
posts.cooked:
Yes Sir, this solution worked for me!

But I was curious that what might have caused this issue?

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Seems like the network you were connected to previously was blocking your connection to port 22. This is probably due to how the firewall’s security settings are setup.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: Where did you acquire the SSH key and login details? I am unable to find them on the portal.

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Watch this video for the process and submit your ssh key here: https://se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in/passwordless
